title: Exceptional tour of an incredible place
text: Arnau gave us a brilliant tour of the Alhambra, so much history and detail about such a vast and complex space! I'm VERY glad I decided to do a guided tour instead of just wandering around myself, I would have appreciated the site just a fraction as much. Thanks Arnau for your boundless energy, enthusiasm and incredible knowledge!

title: Very enjoyable

title: Small group guided tour
text: Carlos was very informative and helpful. He prioritised making us feel very welcome and that our interests were important to him. The Nasrid Palaces were exceedingly beautiful and interesting in particular
author: mornah489

title: Spectacular Alhambra
text: We took the “Skip the Line” small group tour of the Alhambra today. Our guide was Victoria, great! She was energetic, knowledgeable, answered group questions, made sure we stayed together and had a great sense of humor. I highly recommend this tour and Victoria as your guide.

title: Beautiful Day in Alhambra!
text: What a Dream to view Alhambra & Generalife!  Victoria, our Guide, was both historically knowledgeable and able to tell us the ins-and-outs of Alhambra in a fun and enjoyable way.  We all appreciated her sense of humor and patience!  She definitely made centuries of history come alive for us.

author: Z354YNfahada

title: Amazing Alhambra tour with Ana
text: We had an excellent tour with Ana as our guide. She did a great job of explaining the history, architecture and cultural aspects of the Alhambra in a relaxed, informal style.  It felt like a walk with a friend rather than formal tour. She was very knowledgeable and was able to answer questions from botany to geography to the best local tapas restaurants. The site itself is fantastic, both stunning visually and historically fascinating. I highly recommend this tour.
